diagnosis.scope: fixed saved inputs; proposed commands not executed; no closed-loop success evidence

method.selection: First radial path point >= lookahead, else last point, as requested. Jazzy interpolates circle/segment after selecting the point; this port uses the selected grid point. Current main instead accumulates path length.
method.pulse_adaptation: Own pose/path transformed through existing REP105 command frame. Existing measured single-axis 0.1s turn/positive-forward pulses, coast and fresh feedback. No uncalibrated mixed-axis velocity/acceleration, no physical speed input. This ports lookahead/rotation, not continuous curvature/velocity regulation.

tests.initial_fixture_failure: New timeout test passed empty calibration; fixed to use the existing S3 four pulse profile fixture.

references.use: Official Jazzy defaults, radial lookahead and heading rotation.
store_true flags consume no value; omit from legacy workflow manager value-required list.

remaining: 8/8 simulations ended with E2E_WALL_CAP (HOST_ERROR), after 398.05-499.7 SIM seconds; no own-map completion or transport.
B color candidates appeared, but no B boundary validation, route, grasp, carry or setdown was reached.
RPP reduces alternating turns, but issued-command odometry accumulates despite contacts/slip; max evaluation-only map error is 6.98 m. Contact is not proved to explain every error.
Next candidate must estimate executed motion from allowed RGB/history and handle persistent blockage; no ground-truth feedback is permitted.
Jev shadow disagreed 0/6; Jev cost was not available. No physical-hardware evidence or research success is claimed.
measurement_notes: Forward counts issued positive-forward commands; turning signs ignore intervening translations. These are not counts of successful physical displacement.
Online comparisons use seeds 61001/61002, both active robots and the minimum available SIM horizon per seed; A and B are identical within these windows.

Navigation fourth-abort markers were reconstructed from navigation_action_aborted events: the live watcher matched the older reason progress_timeout_blacklist. This affected observations only, not control.
Final health inspection can record INITIAL_OR_PERIODIC_HEALTH_FAILED after a run has exited; this did not stop the run. Wall cap is the terminal cause.
Trace event times and run stage times are SIM seconds; watcher wall times are since submission, while result wall time starts inside the driver.
For missing stages, timestamps are null. Mapping/LLM milestone SIM zero denotes completion of startup with mapping about to begin.
retention: Open PR raw preserved. At PR merge/closure remove DEV heavy originals with cleanup-records while keeping hashes, summaries, LLM text, command trajectories and representative media; no deletion performed in this round.

lifecycle.scope: Only own processes stopped; existing lease/admission and eight-hour guard preserved.

conditions.B: rpp_v1 + Jev v1 with Gemma shadow, seeds 61001-61002

preregistration.success: LLM operated AND own map complete AND start-to-finish transport in the same execution
preregistration.health_policy: DEV conservative health only logged; actual physical failures or runtime errors stop; finite wall cap retained
